text:
emma: Heads-up — dropping a new 'bento' quickstart card layout into first-run. Prototype in Figma: <https://www.figma.com/file/xyz|figma>. Need a quick UX+accessibility pass before I hand to eng.

raj: Nice! Main concerns: footer CTA contrast, keyboard focus when tabbing cards, and how the checklist reveals steps (progressive disclosure).

lina: Agree re contrast. Current CTA is #2f6dd8 on white — fails AAA for 14px. Suggest #0057D9 or add a 2px darker border. Disabled state also too faint.

sarah: On disclosure: we have three CTAs per card — `Use template`, `Try sample`, `Open docs`. Recommend prioritizing a single primary action for new users. I vote 'Try sample' as primary.

mike: Quick technical note: card grid wraps responsively. At 320px the visual order differs from DOM order which breaks keyboard flow. Make DOM order match layout. Also add `aria-describedby` linking to the sample blurb.

emma: Good calls — I'll update the figma: make 'Try sample' primary (solid), 'Use template' secondary (outline). Change focus styles to 3px solid #0057D9 and ensure focus is visible only on keyboard.

raj: Also propose a condensed checklist modal for users who skip quickstart, with a persistent 'resume setup' pill in the header. Should help conversion without forcing flow.

sarah: Copy suggestion: 'Try sample' -> 'Run sample project' is clearer but longer. Might push layout.

lina: :thumbsup: prefer shorter wordings. Maybe 'Run sample' keeps clarity and fits. Also ensure buttons have `aria-label`s matching visible copy.

emma: I'll iterate: switch to 'Run sample', update color to #0057D9, add `aria-label`s, fix DOM order. Also thinking of increasing thumbnail to 64px (from 48px) for better recognition — any objections?

mike: 64px seems right. Also include descriptive alt text like 'Sample: Conversational assistant starter' instead of generic 'thumbnail'.

design-bot: Checklist update: 1) Body text contrast -> AAA ✅ 2) Focus style -> 3px solid #0057D9 ✅ 3) Mobile DOM order fixed ✅ 4) Copy change to 'Run sample' awaiting final approval.

emma: Thanks — I'll push these to the dev ticket and drop a new prototype. Can we do a quick keyboard walkthrough tomorrow at 10:00am? I'll post the updated link here.
